ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is a benzene ring; one end of the benzene ring is connected to a methoxy group (–OCH3), and the other end is connected para to a phosphorus atom, so it is a p-methoxyphenyl substituent. On the phosphorus atom there is also drawn one double-bonded sulfur (P=S), one single-bonded negatively charged sulfur (–S−), and one single-bonded oxygen (–O–). This oxygen is connected to the five-membered ring fragment on the right; adjacent positions in the ring have a positively charged imine nitrogen ([NH+]), and it is shown as a cyclic structure of O–C=[NH+]–C–C–C returning to that carbon; the curved arrows in the figure are ignored according to the problem statement. Reasoning: The p-methoxyphenyl group can be written as COc1ccc(... )cc1, with the phosphorus substituent at the para position to methoxy. The phosphorus center is encoded according to the figure as P(=S)([S-])O. The right-side cyclic imine fragment is connected by this oxygen and is encoded as OC2=[NH+]CCC2. Combining gives the SMILES: COc1ccc(P(=S)([S-])OC2=[NH+]CCC2)cc1.

method.method_draft: First identify the left aryl substituent from the image as p-methoxyphenyl, encode it as COc1ccc(... )cc1 with the phosphorus substituent para to methoxy. Then encode the phosphorus center exactly as drawn: P double-bonded to S, single-bonded to [S-], and single-bonded to O. Finally attach the O to the cyclic iminium fragment as OC2=[NH+]CCC2. Combining these gives COc1ccc(P(=S)([S-])OC2=[NH+]CCC2)cc1.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中左侧是一个苯环，苯环一端连有甲氧基（–OCH3），另一端对位连到磷原子，因此是对甲氧基苯基取代基。磷原子上还画有一个双键硫（P=S）、一个单键带负电的硫（–S−），以及一个单键氧（–O–）。该氧连接到右侧五元环片段，环中相邻位置有带正电的亚胺氮（[NH+]），并显示为 O–C=[NH+]–C–C–C 回到该碳的环状结构；图中的弯箭头按题意忽略。推理：对甲氧基苯基可写作 COc1ccc(... )cc1，磷取代基在甲氧基对位。磷中心按图编码为 P(=S)([S-])O。右侧环状亚胺片段由该氧连接，编码为 OC2=[NH+]CCC2。合并得到 SMILES：COc1ccc(P(=S)([S-])OC2=[NH+]CCC2)cc1。
